newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends shade easier vs dlr in very low trade.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends shade easier vs dlr in very low trade.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended slightly weaker against the dollar in very low trade on Friday as public holidays in Germany and Britain left very little to trade on, traders said.
The forint finished at 176.23/28 against the U.S. unit, compared with its morning opening of 176.10/15, they said, adding that turnover was only a tenth of normal.
"The forint tried to follow a dollar/mark which wasn't actually quoted as Germany was closed and London was closed," said Zsolt Tilimon of Citibank.
The forint stuck right on the central bank's resistance level, which stood at 176.23 to the dollar at the close.
The Hungarian unit moves within the central bank's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
